class.name: MVSuspensionSettings
class.brief_description: Spring, damper, anti-roll bar and alignment of a wheel.
class.description: Shared suspension data referenced by any number of wheels. Angles are stored in radians and edited in degrees; [member camber] and [member toe] are magnitudes, the wheel applies the sign for its side of the vehicle. With [constant SPRING_RATE_AUTO_FROM_LOAD] the spring rate and damping are derived from the static load over the wheel, [member resting_ratio] and [member damping_ratio]. With [constant SPRING_RATE_MANUAL] the values of [member manual_spring_rate] and [member manual_damping] are used directly. The inspector only shows the inputs of the active mode. Every setter clamps the value to its valid range and emits [signal Resource.changed] only when the value actually changed.

members.member: Anti-roll bar stiffness as a ratio of the spring rate.
Multiplier applied to the base damping while the spring compresses. A typical passenger car runs 2/3 bump to 3/2 rebound; race cars typically run 3/2 bump to 2/3 rebound.
Multiplier for the force applied when the suspension is fully compressed. If the vehicle bounces off large bumps, reducing this will help.
Camber angle magnitude in radians. Camber is not simulated, but giving the raycast a slight angle helps simulation stability.
Damping ratio used to calculate the damping forces on the spring. [code]1.0[/code] is critically damped. Passenger cars typically use around [code]0.3[/code], a race car up to [code]0.9[/code].
Damper speed in m/s above which the fast damping rate (half the slow rate) is used. The original script used a constant of 127 mm/s.
Base damper rate in N⋅s/m, used in [constant SPRING_RATE_MANUAL] mode. [member bump_damp_multiplier] and [member rebound_damp_multiplier] still apply.
Spring rate in N/m, used in [constant SPRING_RATE_MANUAL] mode. The default matches what the automatic mode computes for a 1500 kg car with an even weight split.
Multiplier applied to the base damping while the spring extends. See [member bump_damp_multiplier].

How much the spring is compressed when the vehicle is at rest, as a fraction of [member spring_length]. [code]1.0[/code] is fully compressed; with [code]0.5[/code] the suspension rests at the centre of its travel. Used to calculate the spring rate in [constant SPRING_RATE_AUTO_FROM_LOAD] mode.
Whether the spring rate is derived from the load or set manually. See [enum SpringRateMode].

constants.constant: Derive the spring rate and damping from the static load over the wheel, [member resting_ratio] and [member damping_ratio].
Use [member manual_spring_rate] and [member manual_damping] as given.
